items.name: Seomara Cube Fest 2026
items.information:
Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeomaraCubeFest2026#68784-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeomaraCubeFest2026#68785-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 20%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeomaraCubeFest2026#68788-associados-aps-aps-associates).
•
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeomaraCubeFest2026#68784-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeomaraCubeFest2026#68785-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.name: Kublördag Jönköping XI - 2026

venue.name: Per Brahegymnasiet
venue.details: Tävlingen hålls i matsalen, som är en separat byggnad (Brunnsgatan 3). Alltså inte ingång genom skolans huvudentré.

items.information:
Välkomna till Kublördag Jönköping!

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

-----

Welcome to Kublördag Jönköping!

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England.

* [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.cubenewengland.com)
* [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.cubenewengland.com/competitions)
* [Follow us on **Facebook**](https://facebook.com/cubenewengland)
* [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/402975042172435)
* [Join our Facebook community for **parents**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/732527678812618)
* [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/3mX6xKUdRC)

Students & Staff of MSAD 54 can compete in this competition free of charge.  After you have registered, please use your district-issued email address to email Tommy Chestnutt @ tchestnutt@msad54.org.  After confirming relationship with the district, your registration will be accepted.  All other registration requirements remain the same (competiiton limits, registration timeline, etc.).
